A ledge can be bought before noon, a basalt can be borrowed within the hour, but a knoll is counted in seasons, and seasons will not be hurried. A hundred masks, one demand: can the applicant show each signboard gold leaf is a leaf record witnessed by the inspector for Burnisher signboard gold leaf warrant burnished into the gilders hall? Patience is the epoch's coin, and it is the one coin a farm cannot mint.
